chain_words.nuance: a mild willingness to pay attention to something
eager to take part and willing to act
a general energetic interest in a subject or activity
a deep, emotionally driven commitment to a cause
an extreme devotion that refuses to consider other views

explanation: These words all describe strong interest in something, moving from mild attention to a devotion so extreme that it becomes intolerant.

usage_notes.difference: 'Passionate' describes a deep and committed interest; 'fanatical' describes an extreme devotion that often rejects other opinions.
